forward_patch:
--- original
+++ modified
@@ -0,0 +1,33 @@
+---
+position_column: todo
+position_ordinal: 8c80
+title: Resume sends the current-state sync (state_update snapshot, session info) after any replay and before the response, also without replayFrom
+---
+## What
+ACP v2 `session/resume` has a fixed order (v2 Session Setup, "Ordering"): (1) replay the requested history, if any; (2) send a CURRENT `state_update` ("The Agent MUST send a current state_update after any requested history replay and before the resume response", also when no replay was requested); (3) for each item in the `background` list that the replay did not deliver at its current state, send a current `terminal_update` or `tool_call_update` (see the background list task); (4) send current session info with `session_info_update`, and optionally a current `usage_update`; (5) send the response, which carries the current `configOptions` and `availableCommands`. The client must not reset the state to idle when the response arrives. The agent must not send a current update for an entity that the replay already covered at its current state.
+
+Today (read in the code, not run):
+- `replayHistory` in `Sources/FoundationModelsACPAgent/Agent/SessionResume.swift` (near line 471) returns at once when there is no cursor. So a resume with no `replayFrom` sends no sync at all.
+- With a cursor, `replayUpdates(from: .start)` (`Agent/SessionHistory.swift`, near line 150) sends `transcriptUpdates + stateUpdates`. `stateUpdates` (FoundationModelsACP `Session/SessionMergeEngine.swift`, near line 257) includes `agentState`, the RETAINED last `state_update`. Historical state updates must not be replayed as current activity.
+- `SessionStateLedger` (`Agent/PromptState.swift`, near line 48) sends only changes (`promptStarted`, `promptEnded`, `workStarted`, `workEnded`). It has no way to give its current state on demand.
+
+Do:
+1. Add `SessionStateLedger.currentSnapshot()` that gives the CURRENT state: `running`, `requires_action` (a prompt or a request waits for the user), or `idle` (with the last stop reason for context only). Order rule: a snapshot must never replace a newer state; send it through the same sink and the same actor as the changes, so the order holds.
+2. In the resume path, after the replay (or at once when there is no replay), send that snapshot, then `session_info_update`, then the response. Do not replay the retained `agentState` as current. Remove `agentState` from what `replayUpdates` sends, or keep it out of the replay path (check what the retained history still needs it for).
+3. The sync runs for every resume, with or without `replayFrom`. Without `replayFrom` the agent must not replay history.
+4. An idle snapshot announces no new completion or cancellation.
+5. Do not change FoundationModelsACP or the client from this task.
+
+## Acceptance Criteria
+- [ ] A resume with `replayFrom: start` sends: replay, then one current `state_update`, then `session_info_update`, then the response, in that order on the wire.
+- [ ] A resume with no `replayFrom` sends no history, and still sends the current `state_update` and `session_info_update` before the response.
+- [ ] The snapshot shows `running` when a prompt is open at the resume, and `idle` otherwise; a recorded old `running` is never sent as current.
+- [ ] No `state_update` from the retained history is in the replay.
+- [ ] A snapshot never overtakes a newer state change (ordering test).
+
+## Tests
+- [ ] `Tests/FoundationModelsACPAgentTests/ResumeSyncTests.swift`: order with and without a cursor, running and idle snapshots, no retained state in the replay, ordering under a concurrent state change.
+- [ ] Run `swift test --filter ResumeSyncTests`. All pass.
+
+## Workflow
+- Use `/tdd` — write failing tests first, then implement to make them pass. #subagents
\ No newline at end of file
